prompt: Many children today are overweight. This is a serious health issue. Give reasons for child obesity and give solutions to fix this problem.
essay:
Child obesity has become a major health concern in many countries. More children are gaining excess weight at an early age, which increases their risk of diabetes, heart disease, and low self-esteem later in life. This problem is mainly caused by unhealthy eating habits and a lack of physical activity. Therefore, families, schools, and governments must work together to improve children’s diets and lifestyles.

One major cause of child obesity is the widespread consumption of unhealthy food. For example, many children regularly eat fast food, sweets, crisps, and sugary drinks because these products are cheap, tasty, and heavily advertised. As a result, they consume far more calories than their bodies need, while receiving very little nutrition. Parents should therefore limit junk food at home and prepare balanced meals that include fruit, vegetables, protein, and whole grains.

Another important reason is that children are becoming less physically active. For instance, many young people now spend several hours a day watching television, playing video games, or using mobile phones instead of playing outside. This sedentary lifestyle means that they burn fewer calories and gradually gain weight. Schools can help by increasing sports lessons, organising active breaks, and teaching children why regular exercise is essential for long-term health.

In conclusion, child obesity is largely the result of poor diet and insufficient physical activity. I believe this issue can be solved if parents provide healthier food and schools promote more active routines. Governments should also restrict junk-food advertising aimed at children and support public campaigns that encourage healthier habits.
